issue.title: Bug: MACSec test cleanup excessively slow with --per_interface_macsec

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Medium

### Description of the bug

Issue with PR #26782
Related to PR #23895
During cleanup_macsec with --per_interface_macsec configured, cleanup_macsec_multi_profile_configuration is called after any macsec test, which is excessively slow, taking up to an hour.

The issue is that we try to delete all macsec profiles for all VMs, regardless of if the VM actually has the profile

### Steps to Reproduce

Run any `macsec/test_dataplane.py` or any other macsec test with --per_interface_macsec configured.
Observe that cleanup takes a long time.

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

Expect cleanup to not take very long.

Actual behavior in logs, this one step can take an hour:
```
"21/09/2026 <IPV6> macsec_config_helper.cleanup_macsec_mult L0449 INFO   | Multi-profile cleanup step 2: delete per-port profiles\n",
"21/09/2026 <IPV6> macsec_config_helper.cleanup_macsec_mult L0461 INFO   | Multi-profile cleanup step 3: wait for automatic cleanup\n",
```

### Test result

202511: Tests pass both before and after change, however cleanup takes significantly less time

Before: 61 minutes
```
21/09/2026 <IPV6> macsec_config_helper.cleanup_macsec_mult L0449 INFO   | Multi-profile cleanup step 2: delete per-port profiles
21/09/2026 <IPV6> macsec_config_helper.cleanup_macsec_mult L0461 INFO   | Multi-profile cleanup step 3: wait for automatic cleanup
```

After: 30 seconds
```
22/09/2026 <IPV6> macsec_config_helper.cleanup_macsec_mult L0448 INFO   | Multi-profile cleanup step 2: delete per-port profiles
22/09/2026 <IPV6> macsec_config_helper.cleanup_macsec_mult L0457 INFO   | Multi-profile cleanup step 3: wait for automatic cleanup
```

### Approach
#### What is the motivation for this PR?
- Reduce the number of times delete_macsec profile called from VMs*profiles to just profiles
- remove "deleted_profiles" tracking as profile naming is unique per interface
- change devices set to be initialized at the start for readability
#### How did you verify/test it?

Ran `macsec/test_dataplane.py` on a UT2 max topo dut with --per_interface_macsec configured.
Confirmed via test logs that test time taken is reduced.
